policy.rule: A verified audit overrides a publisher README. Adapters pass to the detector only documentation statements that no verified audit has refuted; refuted statements are logged with their refutation instead of being passed as evidence.

policy.enforcement: A refutation is honoured only if refuted_by_task has status done in docs/maintainers/backlog.json (the single authoritative record: only the coordinator sets done, after the independent verifier's done verdict; verify files are not parsed). Statements match entries by exact citation_id (<document>:<locator>, e.g. "gt24-readme:L90-91"), never by substring. Statement and refuted signs must be the integers +1 or -1. Every matching entry is evaluated on channel, citation_id and sign: only the refuted sign is withheld; a statement agreeing with the verified finding is kept.
